newFeatures.title: GitHub Copilot CLI sessions on the board
newFeatures.detail: Running copilot sessions show up on their own, with steps, model, session name and a resume command. Moving them between Orca workspaces is not supported yet.

newFeatures.title: Signal themes
newFeatures.detail: Signal Light and Signal Dark replace Vitesse Light and Ayu Dark. My turn is red and Working is cyan, so the two are easier to tell apart. If you used a replaced theme, you move to Signal automatically.

newFeatures.title: A smaller theme picker with a preview
newFeatures.detail: Settings now has a Light and Dark toggle, a short list of names and a card preview. Hover a theme to preview it, click to apply.
